Topology.title: Government Cloud Segmentation
Topology.Description: Secure cloud infrastructure for government agency with departmental segmentation and centralized monitoring.
Topology.Summary: The topology will include a central hub for management and monitoring, with separate spokes for each department, ensuring secure and isolated environments.

Control.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory System' (n20) that sends inventory data to various nodes, indicating a detailed and maintained asset inventory.

Control.title: Document Data Flows
Control.Evidence: The topology includes numerous data flow links (e.g., nl1, nl2, etc.) and a 'SIEM System' (n5) that collects logs and metrics from various nodes, indicating documented data flows.

Control.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
Control.Evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for different types of data processing and storage, such as 'Sensitive Data Zone' (z6) and 'Non-Production Zone' (z7), indicating proper segmentation based on data sensitivity.

Control.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Central Firewall' (n1) that manages traffic to various zones, indicating the implementation and management of a firewall on servers.

Control.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n13) in the 'Identity Management Zone' (z2), which is likely configured to serve as a trusted DNS server for the enterprise.

Control.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Gateway' (n15) and a 'Remote Access Zone' (z10) with a 'VPN Service' (n21) that connects to the MFA Gateway, indicating that MFA is required for remote network access.

Control.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filter' (n16) that sends logs to the 'Monitoring Server' (n10), indicating the use of DNS filtering services.

Control.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'URL Filter' (n17) that sends logs to the 'Monitoring Server' (n10), indicating the enforcement of network-based URL filters.

Control.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
Control.Evidence: The topology includes multiple zones with defined roles and responsibilities, such as 'Management Hub' (z1), 'Identity Management Zone' (z2), and 'Sensitive Data Zone' (z6), indicating a secure network architecture.

Control.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Central Router' (n7), 'Central Switch' (n8), and 'Central IDS/IPS' (n9) in the 'Management Hub' (z1), indicating securely managed network infrastructure.

Control.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' (n2) and an 'Access Control System' (n22) in the 'Remote Access Zone' (z10), indicating centralized network AAA.

Control.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'VPN Service' (n21) and an 'MFA Gateway' (n15) in the 'Remote Access Zone' (z10), indicating that remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

Control.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Central IDS/IPS' (n9) in the 'Management Hub' (z1), indicating the deployment of a network intrusion detection solution.

Control.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Central Firewall' (n1) that manages traffic between various zones, indicating traffic filtering between network segments.

Control.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Access Control System' (n22) in the 'Remote Access Zone' (z10), indicating the management of access control for remote assets.

Control.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'SIEM System' (n5) that collects logs and metrics from various nodes, indicating the collection of network traffic flow logs.

Control.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
Control.Evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for production ('Workload Zone' z4) and non-production ('Non-Production Zone' z7) systems, indicating separation of production and non-production systems.

Control.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'External Pen Tester' (n_new1) and a 'Pen Testing Workstation' (n23) in the 'External Testing Zone' (z8), indicating the capability to perform periodic external penetration tests.
